problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet to four distinct delivery routes, each requiring passage through four separate checkpoint stations. The revenue generated per ton of cargo delivered on each route is as follows:
* For Route Alpha, revenue is 19.802 per ton
* For Route Beta, revenue is 11.027 per ton
* For Route Gamma, revenue is 15.178 per ton
* For Route Delta, revenue is 9.743 per ton

The handling duration required per ton of cargo at each checkpoint is detailed below:
* For Route Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.584 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.491 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.204 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.681 (ton-hours)
* For Route Beta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.151 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.376 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.414 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.369 (ton-hours)
* For Route Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.773 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.704 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.961 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.38 (ton-hours)
* For Route Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.737 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.914 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.346 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.694 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 1 must not exceed 175.744 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 2 must not exceed 124.507 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 3 must not exceed 70.456 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 4 must not exceed 170.158 hours

Under the stipulation that the total processing time at each checkpoint—Checkpoint 1, Checkpoint 2, Checkpoint 3, and Checkpoint 4—remains within its allotted capacity, determine the optimal cargo allocation across the routes to maximize total revenue.
